# Fynerisor

Risor v2 language bindings for the Fyne GUI framework: cross-platform desktop
apps written in Risor scripts, plus a headless (`core`) runtime for CLI and
server use.

Version: 0.9.0 · Risor v2.2+ · Fyne v2.8+ · Go 1.27 · module `github.com/uidbz/fynerisor`

> Start with the "Optional"-style rule: the per-type script API reference is
> **generated** from the compiled code and CI-pinned. For any exact attribute,
> argument, or method name, read `docs/API.md` (or run `fynerisor docs`).
> Do not answer API questions from prose.

## Documentation

- [README.md](README.md): entry point — quick start, library usage (Go host examples), configuration options, module table, CLI, concurrency summary.
- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md): the full guide — every module's functions, script imports, options, architecture, testing.
- [docs/API.md](docs/API.md): **authoritative generated API reference** (all script-visible types and attributes; `fynerisor docs [--json]` regenerates; CI fails on drift).
- [docs/CONCURRENCY.md](docs/CONCURRENCY.md): threading model — the VM goroutine, guithread marshalling, `go()` semantics, host-side `Window.Do`.
- [docs/TIE_MODULE.md](docs/TIE_MODULE.md): the Tie triple-store module.
- [docs/EXAMPLES.md](docs/EXAMPLES.md): worked example walkthroughs.
- [docs/NAMING_CONVENTIONS.md](docs/NAMING_CONVENTIONS.md): naming rules for wrappers/attributes.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): per-version changes, breaking changes highlighted.

## Agent skill (guidance for AI assistants)

- [skill/SKILL.md](skill/SKILL.md): canonical agent guidance — Risor syntax rules, `match` gotchas, threading model, common mistakes.
- [skill/references/fynerisor-reference.md](skill/references/fynerisor-reference.md): distilled operational knowledge (semantics, gotchas, patterns; no API dumps).
- [skill/references/scroll-bindings.md](skill/references/scroll-bindings.md): scroll container bindings, no-sleep rule.

## Examples and code

- [examples/](examples/): runnable example apps, each with a README (start with `examples/hello.risor` and `examples/01-hello-world`).
- [core/](core/): headless runtime (no GUI deps; static-build friendly).
- [gui/](gui/): Fyne GUI runtime, widget/container/canvas/chart/binding wrappers.
- [modules/](modules/): Risor modules — http, sql, os, io, json, csv, exec, tie, time, strings, filepath.
- [cmd/fynerisor/](cmd/fynerisor/): CLI — `run`, `check` (compile-only), `analyze`, `docs`.

## Contributing

- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): contributor/agent guide — architecture rules, CI gates, docs map (which file owns which kind of fact).
- [docs/CODE_REVIEW.md](docs/CODE_REVIEW.md) and [docs/IMPROVEMENTS.md](docs/IMPROVEMENTS.md): historical review notes and roadmap context.
